```ts
return Math.round(netAmount * (1 + TAX_RATE) * 100) / 100;
```

- The comment on line 3 says "rounded to cents", but the code doesn't round.

The other 3 tests pass.

`Cart.grossTotal()` calls `addTax`, so after the fix it will round to cents too. That's the behavior the comment describes.
